races.name: Connolly's RED MILLS Irish EBF Auction Maiden Hurdle (IRE Incentive Race)

runners_data.name: Ifallgoeswell
runners_data.comment: Top rated at 116, okay run on h'cap bow latest, in the mix back in a maiden
runners_data.spotlight: Top rated here at 116 and plenty of placed efforts in bumpers and maiden hurdles; not a bad run on handicap debut at Cork five days ago and should be on the premises back in a maiden, although has to give weight away to all.

runners_data.name: Great Entirely
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on sole point start in December, can only be watched for now
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up on sole point start in December; can only be watched on Rules' debut.

runners_data.name: Poet's Duke
runners_data.comment: Debut run not devoid of promise, bred to act on better ground, interesting for local yard
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at 6-1 on debut at Naas (2m, sft-hvy) and while he only finished seventh, it wasn't a run devoid of promise; pedigree suggests he'll improve for better ground and he's an interesting runner for local yard.

runners_data.name: Dunleer Crystal
runners_data.comment: Rated 114, well treated by race conditions, testing ground excuse latest, big chance
runners_data.spotlight: Rated 114 and kindly treated by race conditions; standout effort a 2.25l second behind Los Blanco at Down Royal (2m1f, yielding); testing ground may not have suited at Naas on latest; half-brother to a winner at this trip and big chance back on a sounder surface.

runners_data.name: Nameyourgame
runners_data.comment: Placed in one of two points, beaten 48l on hurdles debut, others appeal more
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in one of two points but beaten 48l on hurdles debut at Clonmel two weeks ago; others appeal more.

runners_data.name: All Night Revival
runners_data.comment: Went close in a bumper, respectable 2m maiden runs last twice, moves up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Went close in a Fairyhouse bumper on Rules' debut; decent efforts in 2m maiden hurdles at Gowran (heavy) and back at Fairyhouse (heavy) the last twice; needs to find improvement for this longer trip and quicker ground to win.

runners_data.name: The First Turn
runners_data.comment: Well backed for debut bumper win, poor latest but bred for this game, not dismissed
runners_data.spotlight: Well backed and duly won a Thurles bumper (15.5f, gd-yld) on debut in October; always behind when beating just one rival home at Leopardstown in December and off since; bred to make a hurdler and in good hands so not dismissed.

runners_data.name: De Jour En Jour
runners_data.comment: Rated 105, respectable runs in maidens on testing ground, quicker conditions a query
runners_data.spotlight: Has run okay in three maiden hurdles at 2m1f-2m7f on testing ground without really threatening to win; rated 105 and needs to find a bit more improvement to get his head in front; pulled up twice on quicker ground in points, which is a concern.

runners_data.name: Loyal Praetorian
runners_data.comment: Rated 102, hasn't built on Clonmel second, pulled up in handicap latest, needs more
runners_data.spotlight: Hasn't really fired since a Clonmel maiden hurdle second in December; pulled up on handicap debut at Cork on latest; rated 102 and needs more back in maiden company.

runners_data.name: Miss Donna
runners_data.comment: Similar level of form in a bumper and two maiden hurdles, much more needed
runners_data.spotlight: Has run to similar RPRs in the mid-80s in a bumper and two maiden hurdles; much more needed.

runners_data.name: Captains Speech
runners_data.comment: Point winner, excellent second on Rules' bow at Cork, leading chance
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner found just Royal Gladiator too good on hurdles debut at Cork (2m4f, yielding) when the 2-1 joint favourite and the fourth from that race won a maiden at Cork last weekend; leading claims.

runners_data.name: Le Moulin Rouge
runners_data.comment: Promise here on debut, fine run at Leopardstown latest, leading chance for local yard
runners_data.spotlight: Promising third behind stablemate on debut here (16.5f, yielding) in October, shaping like this trip would suit; ran a blinder upped to 20.5f at Leopardstown (gd-yld) in December behind Lazare De Star (Royal Gladiator 3.25l behind); locally trained and leading chance on form.

runners_data.name: Davitts Quay
runners_data.comment: 150-1 and never sighted on debut at Clonmel, may need more time
runners_data.spotlight: 150-1 and always near the back on debut at Clonmel; may need more time.

runners_data.name: King Maxios
runners_data.comment: Maxios gelding, dam 9.4f AW winner, tongue tied for debut, best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Maxios gelding; dam 9.4f AW winner (RPR 61), half-sister to useful 1m4f winner Sayadaw, out of 1m2f winning sister to high-class 1m-1m2f performer Johann Quatz and half-sister to French Derby winner Hernando; tongue-tie on for debut; watch.

runners_data.name: Rattledelatch
runners_data.comment: Pulled up on debut at Gowran, upped in trip now and hooded, not easy to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 and pulled up on debut at Gowran (2m, heavy); hood goes on and steps up in trip; not easy to make a case for him.

runners_data.name: Seekthisfairland
runners_data.comment: Quest For Peace gelding, half-brother to 2m-2m1f winner, watch unless market speaks
runners_data.spotlight: Quest For Peace gelding; half-brother to point/2m1f hurdle winner Captain Cool; dam point winner, half-sister to 2m-2m2f hurdle/chase winner Tryptonic, out of dual 2m hurdle winner; best watched on debut unless the market speaks.

runners_data.name: Sir Topham Hatt
runners_data.comment: Easy point wins last twice, dam a sister to Lord Windermere, could go well; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; wide margin wins in small field points at Ballygogue House and Liscarroll on last two starts, both on soft; clearly has some level of ability and dam a sister to Lord Windermere; could go well if gets a run.

runners_data.name: The Rebel Fox
runners_data.comment: Placed in three points, definite promise on hurdles debut, place shout
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in all three starts in points; not a bad run at all on hurdles debut at Naas, staying on late for a 15l fifth; more needed to win this but open to improvement and has a place chance.

runners_data.name: Green Angel
runners_data.comment: Promise in both starts, needs to find a bit more to get his head in front
runners_data.spotlight: Solid fourth in a 2m1f Down Royal maiden hurdle (yielding) in December; below that level upped to this trip on soft at Ayr in February but was still a decent run; needs to find a bit more to get his head in front.

runners_data.name: Tinto De Verano
runners_data.comment: Promise in first two bumpers inc' here, ground will suit for hurdles debut; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; not bad efforts in first two bumpers, here (yielding) and at Leopardstown (gd-yld), but no show on soft on latest in another bumper at Thurles; return to better ground a plus for hurdles debut.

runners_data.name: Sam's Favourite
runners_data.comment: Miles behind Captains Speech on sole completed start at Cork, look elsewhere
runners_data.spotlight: Refused at the second on debut at Leopardstown; miles behind Captains Speech on sole completed start at Cork; look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Cornaroya Rocco
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in a bumper, pulled up  in a Fairyhouse maiden hurdle, put a line through
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off on debut in Galway bumper and pulled up on hurdles debut at Fairyhouse when a 300-1 shot; put a line through.

runners_data.name: Pilgrims Walk
runners_data.comment: Never involved in either maiden hurdle run, will find level in handicaps; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; always out the back in maiden hurdles at Cork and Limerick; may find his level in handicaps.

runners_data.name: Silly Mongoose
runners_data.comment: Modest form in three bumpers, can only be watched on first start over timber
runners_data.spotlight: Modest efforts in a trio of bumpers at 2m-2m2f; can only be watched on first start over timber.

runners_data.name: Imarajan
runners_data.comment: Dual-purpose maiden, okay runs in both maiden hurdles, needs more on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden for Eddie and Patrick Harty; similar RPRs (low 90s) when fifth at Gowran and fourth at Fairyhouse; needs more on debut for new yard after a break.

runners_data.name: Nebraska Brave
runners_data.comment: No impact at huge prices in three maiden hurdles, hood now reached for
runners_data.spotlight: Triple-figure odds and has run accordingly in three maiden hurdles at 2m-2m2f; hood now reached for.

runners_data.name: Calm Flight Ahead
runners_data.comment: Zero impact in three previous maidens, unlikely winner
runners_data.spotlight: Unlikely winner based on the evidence of his three previous maiden hurdle efforts.

runners_data.name: Ceroc
runners_data.comment: Course winner at 3m but losing run mounting, pulled up in chase latest, others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Has won twice over hurdles, including here over 3m, but losing run mounting and was pulled up in a Clonmel novices' handicap chase on latest; others arrive in better form.

runners_data.name: Noble Talent
runners_data.comment: Struggled this season inc' back over hurdles latest, below last winning mark the only plus
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled in chases in first three runs this term and similar story back over hurdles at Cork on latest; has slipped below his last winning mark but not many other positives.

runners_data.name: Cowper Hall
runners_data.comment: Raised 14lb for F'house win, below best in chases last twice, could rebound in this sphere
runners_data.spotlight: Won off 14lb lower on last run over timber at Fairyhouse in December; last two runs in chases, unseating at Tramore and well beaten at Thurles; could rebound returned to this discipline.

runners_data.name: Teenage Kiss
runners_data.comment: Hinted like turn is near last twice, this trip should suit, ran well here before, chance
runners_data.spotlight: Has hinted like his turn is near the last twice; kept on well for a 2.25l fourth over 2m3f at Naas on latest so this extra furlong could eke out more and he's gone well here before; leading chance.

runners_data.name: Bocelli's Voice
runners_data.comment: Course winner over fences, out of form in recent starts, new headgear combo tried
runners_data.spotlight: Won his beginners' chase here in April 2024 but no joy since and he was pulled up when last seen in a Down Royal handicap chase in February; new headgear combination needs to spark.

runners_data.name: Miss Mini Bee
runners_data.comment: Running respectably over hurdles, placed on heavy latest, quicker ground a query
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner has been running respectably over hurdles; finished a 4.75l third of 13 at Gowran (2m4f, heavy) last month; same mark here but quicker ground a query.

runners_data.name: Accustomed
runners_data.comment: Narrowly denied at Down Royal latest, form been boosted, big player off 3lb higher
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner; built on promise of a solid run at Leopardstown in December when narrowly denied at Down Royal (20.5f, yielding) last month and the sixth from that race has won since; should be bang there again off 3lb higher with Kennedy booked.

runners_data.name: Hitthehayson
runners_data.comment: Back to back chase wins in Nov'-Dec', failed to exploit lower hurdles mark latest
runners_data.spotlight: Back to back chase wins at Fairyhouse (3m, heavy) and Haydock (2m4f, gd-sft) last November-December; rated failed to exploit his lower hurdles mark back over timber at Navan in February and off since; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Takarengo
runners_data.comment: No win since 2021, poor on Flat latest, should be fitter but hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: No win since 2021 and while he has occasionally run well in defeat, his comeback run on the Flat at Navan last month was poor; should strip fitter but hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Sean Mc
runners_data.comment: In good form before trip may have stretched latest, chance if acts on better ground
runners_data.spotlight: Ran excellent races when runner up at Fairyhouse (2m4f, soft) and Punchestown (19.5f, sft-hvy); trip may have stretched him when well beaten latest but he's unproven on better ground; chance if he acts on it (half-brother won on good).

runners_data.name: Great Bird
runners_data.comment: Has shown winning potential, below best last twice but could rebound; cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Sound efforts in first two handicaps and held every chance when falling at the last at Thurles in October (22.5f, gd-yld); below best the last twice but could rebound dropped in trip and returned to better ground; cheekpieces on.

runners_data.name: Glendine Billy
runners_data.comment: 0-12 over hurdles, hard to fancy on recent showings, cheekpieces left off; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; 0-12 over hurdles; has a couple of placed efforts to his name but hard to fancy on recent showings; cheekpieces tried last time discarded.

runners_data.name: Stumblin In
runners_data.comment: Lost way after Tramore win last April, off since August, best watched on return; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; lost form after winning at Tramore last April; off since a poor run at that venue last August; likely best watched on return.

runners_data.name: Annie's Belle
runners_data.comment: H'cap debutante, hinted at promise in maidens, hood on, yard in form could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Handicap debutante has hinted at promise in maidens at 2m-2m2f; hood added to tongue tie and two of yard's last four runners have won; could go well.

runners_data.name: Ersudaly
runners_data.comment: Point winner, no show in maidens, hood on for handicap debut, ground should suit
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner (on good to yielding) didn't show a whole lot in three maiden hurdles at 2m-3m on soft ground; hooded for her handicap debut, this ground will suit and worth checking in the market.

runners_data.name: Humble Brag
runners_data.comment: Remote fourth on 2m h'cap debut, bred to stay this far, still early days, not discounted
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in maidens and his fourth on handicap debut at Clonmel (2m, heavy) was a remote one; pedigree suggests this longer trip will suit and it's still early days for this well bred gelding; dropped 1lb and not discounted.

runners_data.name: Speakasyoufind
runners_data.comment: 0-7 over hurdles, pulled up on chase debut latest, cheekpieces reached for; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; placed in a point but generally poor form over hurdle; pulled up on chase debut at Fairyhouse on latest in January; cheekpieces tried now.

races.name: Irish Injured Jockeys Rated Novice Hurdle

runners_data.name: Walks The Talk
runners_data.comment: Struggled on heavy in Gr' 3 latest but solid form on better ground, should go well
runners_data.spotlight: Form figures of 1521 on ground with good in the description, the fifth coming in a listed mares' hurdle at Haydock; floundered on heavy in a Gowran Grade 3 on latest but return to better ground a huge plus; should go well.

runners_data.name: Long Branch
runners_data.comment: Point winner, Thurles novice win in Dec', beaten when unseating latest, must bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Point winner gained first win under Rules in a Thurles novice (22.5f, yld-sft) in December; 5.5l third under a penalty back there on his next start and unseated when on the retreat on handicap debut at Down Royal on latest; 3m no problem but needs to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Agameoftwohalves
runners_data.comment: Punchestown maiden hurdle winner on latest, big step up in trip, chance if he stays
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the fourth attempt in maiden hurdles, scoring by 2l at Punchestown (2m3f, sft-hvy) in February; steps up markedly in trip now and unproven on better ground (half-brother won on good); chance if he stays (mixed messages in pedigree).

runners_data.name: Rocky's Howya
runners_data.comment: Prolific pointer, won last three on testing ground, not sure sounder surface will suit
runners_data.spotlight: Prolific pointer is on a four-timer after notching up wins in claiming hurdles at Limerick (2m5f, heavy) and Naas (2m6f, sft-hvy) and a handicap chase at Limerick (2m7f, heavy); has to prove his effectiveness on better ground, however.

runners_data.name: Jisco Du Brem
runners_data.comment: Good ground bumper winner, 13l third on h'cap debut latest, more needed to win this
runners_data.spotlight: Bumper winner (on good ground) is 0-4 over hurdles and rated 105; kept on for a 17l third of 13 at Thurles (2m7f, sft-hvy) on handicap debut latest; return to better ground a positive but needs more to take this.

runners_data.name: Ho My Lord
runners_data.comment: 0-12 chasing; declining mark but hard to fancy, although better ground in his favour
runners_data.spotlight: No success yet over fences and is beginning to look well exposed, the addition of cheekpieces (replaced here by blinkers) failing to bring improvement the last twice; declining mark but hard to fancy, although better ground in his favour.

runners_data.name: Choccabloc
runners_data.comment: Pulled up at Fairyhouse on Saturday; quicker ground will need to bring lots of improvement
runners_data.spotlight: 128-rated hurdler for Nicky Henderson; remote second in 2m6f Fairyhouse novice his best run over fences for current yard, most recently pulled up after never travelling in 2m5f Fairyhouse handicap on Saturday; hard to fancy unless quicker ground brings serious improvement.

runners_data.name: Cloonainra
runners_data.comment: Down Royal run more encouraging; down 2lb since then and ground to suit so could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Has reached a similar standard over fences as hurdles, winning debut in 2m4f Listowel mares novice in September but well held until more encouraging effort last month on better ground, despite tending to jump left in 2m5f Down Royal rated novice last month in first-time cheekpieces; down 2lb since then and ground to suit so could go well.

runners_data.name: The Great Nudie
runners_data.comment: Disappointing since Naas maiden win; return to 2m4f may suit on handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner got off the mark over fences when making all in 2m4f Naas beginners' in January (soft); well below that level both starts since however, may not have stayed 3m at Naas and tame effort when favourite in 2m6f Thurles mares' Listed contest after again forcing it; back in trip here on better ground on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Duffys Hodey
runners_data.comment: Up 9lb for recent Limerick win but still nicely treated compared to hurdles mark
runners_data.spotlight: Decent performer at a modest enough level, three hurdle wins and twice successful over fences off lower marks this term in Limerick handicaps, most recently last month when patiently-ridden to lead two out for ready 11l win (2m4f, soft); up 9lb but remains 10lb lower than hurdles so remains very much of interest.

runners_data.name: Tequila Talkin'
runners_data.comment: C&D maiden hurdle winner; straight into handicap company for chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: Highlight of eight runs over hurdles when winning C&D maiden last July (good); has struggled in handicaps, testing conditions at Leopardstown probably not suiting last twice; straight into handicap company for chase debut and likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Mahon's Way
runners_data.comment: Yet to prove himself chasing but 12lb lower than hurdles; absent since July
runners_data.spotlight: Grade 3-placed hurdler nowhere near that level in four chase starts, okay effort in 2m4f Naas beginners'; absent since disappointing favourite on handicap debut over 2m at Tipperary last July, fading tamely from last after racing up with pace; trip more in his favour on comeback and still scope for improvement off 12lb lower chase mark.

runners_data.name: Ballybrittas
runners_data.comment: Absent since tame effort at Roscommon in June; probably best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Winning point-to-pointer and hurdler; runner-up on first two attempts chasing, in beginners' at Thurles (2m5f) and Clonmel (2m1f) last season, absent since tame effort at Roscommon (good) in June; probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Park Of Kings
runners_data.comment: Recent handicap debut leaves him with lots to find but better ground should suit
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time hurdles winner; beaten a long way in three beginners' chases this term, most recently never counted on handicap debut in Naas Listed contest in February; hurdles form on better ground so these improved conditions could see improvement (10lb lower than over hurdles).

runners_data.name: Three In A Row
runners_data.comment: Recent Navan handicap fourth wasn't a bad effort, this more his trip so one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: Winning hurdler; 0-11 chasing but rated 3lb superior in this discipline after runner-up finishes at Punchestown (2m4f, yielding to soft) and Naas (2m4f, heavy); recent 2m1f Navan handicap fourth wasn't a bad effort, this more his trip so one to consider.

runners_data.name: James The Brave
runners_data.comment: Every chance when unseating two out at Limerick; big player if avoiding serious error
runners_data.spotlight: Killarney handicap winner in October (2m7f, yielding) and took advantage of lower hurdles mark at Punchestown in February before third in a similar event; well-backed favourite back chasing last month, disputing lead (clear of remainder) when unseating two out at Limerick (2m2f, heavy); remains very much of interest off 2lb higher mark.

runners_data.name: Harty Cup
runners_data.comment: Improved hurdler of late now goes chasing; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Slow-burner over hurdles but has shown improved form since going handicapping and was a decisive winner over 2m1f at Clonmel in February (heavy); never-nearer third here over 2m following month off 10lb higher mark and now switches attention to fences.

races.name: BOYLE Sports Supporting Irish Racing Veterans Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Fakir d'Oudairies
runners_data.comment: Grade 1 winner hasn't convinced at cross-country hard to assess now; trip/ground to suit
runners_data.spotlight: Four-time Grade 1 chase winner (peaked at 167) for Joseph O'Brien but left yard after a disappointing cross-country debut in December 2024; just okay efforts back on cross-country circuit of late, at Punchestown and when not looking to stay 3m6f at Cheltenham last month; back over the conventional fences here and hard to assess (trip/ground to suit) but handicapper giving him every chance.

runners_data.name: Bythesametoken
runners_data.comment: This probably the limit of his stamina but place claims
runners_data.spotlight: Winner here over hurdles and third chase win came in 2m2f Listowel handicap chase last September (off 116) after more than a year's absence; another good comeback run at Haydock in February, not so good at Kelso a fortnight later over shorter trip; this probably the limit of his stamina.

runners_data.name: Farmers Lodge
runners_data.comment: Absent a year but still unexposed over fences; interesting
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 10yo won Fairyhouse beginners chase in early 2024 and later same year back-to-back wins in handicap hurdles at Fairyhouse and Punchestown; absent since pulled up in 2m6f Fairyhouse handicap hurdle a year ago; unexposed on only fourth chase start, good fourth on only previous handicap run (off 130); interesting but may need this.

runners_data.name: Flash De Touzaine
runners_data.comment: Lacks a recent run but trip/ground in his favour so local challenger respected
runners_data.spotlight: Gained the most recent of his three chase wins in a 2m3f handicap on good ground at Ballinrobe last May; lacks a recent run but trip/ground in his favour so local challenger respected.

runners_data.name: Watch The Weather
runners_data.comment: Form earlier this season below best but noteworthy jockey booking on return to action
runners_data.spotlight: Won over fences last season, over C&D (good) and on soft at Punchestown (2m6f) off this mark; form earlier this season not so good, absent since never counting in Munster National in October; noteworthy jockey booking on return to action.

runners_data.name: The Folkes Tiara
runners_data.comment: Below best this season, cheekpieces now added to usual tongue-tie
runners_data.spotlight: Both chase wins hae been in quite valuable 2m1f handicaps (yielding), most recently at Fairyhouse in November 2024; below best this season, beaten nearly 20l over same trip at Leopardstown over Christmas on latest; cheekpieces now added to usual tongue-tie.

runners_data.name: Union Park
runners_data.comment: Safely held over hurdles of late, of limited appeal back chasing
runners_data.spotlight: Better chaser than hurdler, although hasn't won since taking 2m4f Cork handicap hurdle in November 2023; safely held over hurdles of late, of limited appeal back chasing.

runners_data.name: Supreme Jet
runners_data.comment: Solid first handicap effort at Limerick last month, could go well
runners_data.spotlight: Better hurdler but has performed respectably in beginners' chases this season, runner-up at Cork (2m, yielding) and led most of the way when fourth at Down Royal (2m4f yielding); solid first handicap effort at Limerick last month, having travelled well into the race; could go well.

runners_data.name: A Wave Of The Sea
runners_data.comment: Trip/ground here and drops in grade; contender
runners_data.spotlight: Fine servant won a Grade 1 juvenile hurdle and most recent successes came in 2m4f Kilbeggan handicap chases last year; penultimate Thurles fourth his best recent effort, stamina test probably beyond him in valuable 2m6f Leopardstown handicap latest; more suitable trip/ground here and drops in grade.

runners_data.name: Dont Go Yet
runners_data.comment: Winning hurdler here last month; last year's second with obvious claims off 7lb lower mark
runners_data.spotlight: Dual chase winner who got off the mark over hurdles here last month in decisive fashion, going clear on the run-in over 2m (soft); second in this race last year (Krabat third) off 7lb higher so obvious claims (1lb wrong).

runners_data.name: The Banger Doyle
runners_data.comment: Recent form good bit below best so needs to bounce back (better ground may suit)
runners_data.spotlight: Three chase wins, the latest two back in 2024, best run last summer when touched off over 2m at Punchestown; more recent form good bit below best so needs to bounce back (better ground may suit).

runners_data.name: Krabat
runners_data.comment: Recent Limerick winner on preferred heavy; near career-high mark now and quicker ground
runners_data.spotlight: In good form this season, gaining second Limerick win last month, coming late under patient ride to win going away (2m4f) on preferred heavy ground; nudged up to near career-high mark now and quicker ground a slight concern.

runners_data.name: General Clermont
runners_data.comment: Long absent but trip/ground in his favour; 4lb wrong if getting in; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Reserve; better chaser than hurdler, although hasn't won since scoring over C&D in August 2024 off 8lb lower mark, standout run when close second over 2m6f at Listowel in September; soft ground probably against him at Limerick following month and has been absent since; 4lb wrong.

runners_data.name: Caesar Rock
runners_data.comment: Recent second to Krabat at Limerick; better ground could see him turn the tables
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran with modest strike rate including 2m6f Tramore chase last summer on good; comes here in decent form though, most recently second to Krabat in 2m4f Limerick handicap last month after a break, having every chance; better ground here could see him turn the tables on that rival (1lb wrong).

runners_data.name: Fighting Fit
runners_data.comment: Below form hurdling since October return; back chasing off much higher mark here
runners_data.spotlight: Better chaser, although last win came over 2m1f at Listowel festival in 2023 (off 132); encouraging hurdles return at Galway in October but hasn't built on that in three starts since; back chasing here off considerably higher mark so claims not obvious but yard going well.

runners_data.name: Digby
runners_data.comment: Best form over further, opposable on recent form
runners_data.spotlight: Sole chase win came in 3m Bangor handicap a year ago, following month added 2m7f Ballinrobe handicap hurdle; way below best this season, most recently pulled up after never travelling over inaedquate 2m here last month; again this trip on the short side.

runners_data.name: Brideswell Lad
runners_data.comment: Yet to convince since January return from long absence
runners_data.spotlight: Six-time chase winner (including here) but not since May 2024; missed 2025 entirely and hasn't convinced since January return over both hurdles and fences.

runners_data.name: Person Of Interest
runners_data.comment: Recent form leaves him with plenty to find, visor now replaces cheekpieces
runners_data.spotlight: Won over this trip at Downpatrick last summer but recent form leaves him with plenty to find, never travelling last time at Plumpton; visor now replaces cheekpieces.

runners_data.name: Finnians Row
runners_data.comment: C&D winner off this mark last summer; better for recent comeback run and ground to suit
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner last August off this mark (good); pulled up on last month's comeback here on soft but entitled to come on for that and ground coming in his favour.

runners_data.name: Elusive Prince
runners_data.comment: 0-15 for previous yards; debuts for new yard and hard to fancy
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner was unable to make the breakthrough under rules for both Henry de Bromhead and Jimmy Barcoe; debuts for new yard and hard to fancy off this mark.

runners_data.name: Warm In Gorey
runners_data.comment: C&D second last summer off 5lb higher but has failed to complete last three outings
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winner over hurdles, 0-17 chasing but C&D second last summer off 5lb higher; has failed to complete last three outings so very hard to be confident in.

runners_data.name: North Of Nashville
runners_data.comment: 3m1f winner here in the past; potential improver back on better ground; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; sole win came here in 3m1f handicap in 2023 (yielding); very lightly raced since, soft/heavy probably against her of late; potential improver back on better ground.

runners_data.name: Oogum Boogum
runners_data.comment: 18-race maiden hurdler; lack of previous experience a negative here on chase debut
runners_data.spotlight: 18-race maiden hurdler has run okay here in the past; debuts over fences in handicap company and inexperience a likely negative.

runners_data.name: My Good Pal
runners_data.comment: Unexposed on return to fences and better ground could suit
runners_data.spotlight: Won 2m4f handicap hurdle here in August under today's regular rider and some decent placings afterwards; unseated on chase debut last year when in front three from home at Downpatrick but didn't feature subsequently on softer ground at Ballinrobe; unexposed on return to fences and better ground could suit.

runners_data.name: Butty O Brien
runners_data.comment: Fair C&D third last month mildly encouraging; much more needed and cheekpieces tried
runners_data.spotlight: Dual hurdle winner; 0-5 chasing but mild encouragement last month over C&D when modest enough third to Connemara Shore (soft); much more needed and cheekpieces tried.

runners_data.name: Malton Groove
runners_data.comment: Last year's second not in same kind of form of late but now 6lb lower
runners_data.spotlight: Long standing maiden runner-up in this race last year off 95 (yielding); hasn't been shaping as though his turn is near in recent starts, pulled up at Down Royal over Christmas; handicapper giving him every chance though.

runners_data.name: Baltinglass Hill
runners_data.comment: Back from a break, handicapper has given him every chance and better ground to suit
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time winning hurdler is 0-13 chasing, pulled up after some indifferent jumping last time; back from a break, handicapper has given him every chance and better ground in his favour.

runners_data.name: Nolans Rocco
runners_data.comment: Recent Limerick winner; 6lb rise probably workable although different ground conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Point-to-point winner got off the mark under rules last month in 2m7f Limerick handicap chase despite hanging left late on; 6lb rise probably workable although different ground conditions now.

runners_data.name: Rockstown Girl
runners_data.comment: Recent hurdles winner relatively unexposed chasing; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Was gaining her third career hurdles win when returning to form at Down Royal last month, taking advantage of reduced mark and drop in grade over 2m5f (Rajjnatin third); 0-5 chasing, though was going okay when brought down three from home in 2m5f Fairyhouse handicap; 3lb lower here so respected.

runners_data.name: Driveonwill
runners_data.comment: Drop in trip and better ground could suit and 6yo has more scope for improvement than most
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden hurdler had been making the frame on soft before pitched straight into handicap company for chase debut last month, travelling well for long way before tiring over 2m6f at Thurles; drop in trip and better ground could bring improvement and this 6yo has more scope than most.

runners_data.name: Patsy's Pride
runners_data.comment: May have not stayed 3m on recent chase debut; drop in trip may suit here; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; yet to trouble the judge over hurdles and on recent chase debut when ran okay in 3m Clonmel novice handicap without looking to stay; drop in trip may suit and better ground.

runners_data.name: Spread The Faith
runners_data.comment: 0-7 over hurdles; headgear on for chase debut but very hard to be confident in; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; 0-7 over hurdles and yet to trouble the judge, pulled up last twice; new headgear combination tried for chase debut but very hard to be confident in.

runners_data.name: Eddies Pride
runners_data.comment: Last win came off 85; wants further and softer ground
runners_data.spotlight: Both chase wins have been over further and on softer ground; pulled up the last twice, impossible task at weights second occasion in Limerick veterans handicap; down in grade but still hard to make a case for.

runners_data.name: Barely Made It
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced mare a maiden in points and under rules; yard debut and market may guide
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced mare a maiden in both point-to-points and under rules for James Grace; yard debut and market may guide.

runners_data.name: Connemara Shore
runners_data.comment: Clear of third-placed Butty O'Brien in C&D win last month; big chance of follow-up win
runners_data.spotlight: Winning pointer with placed hurdles form and off the mark chasing at the second attempt in C&D handicap last month in first-time blinkers, showing good attitude to shrug off a strong favourite (pair clear of third-placed Butty O'Brien); 7lb rise looks fine, big chance of a follow-up win if handling quicker conditions.

runners_data.name: Rajjnatin
runners_data.comment: Down Royal hurdle third to Rockstown Girl on yard debut; same terms switched to fences now
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in maidens and handicaps for Evanna McCutcheon, more encouraging yard debut in 2m5f Down Royal handicap hurdle last month when well backed, finishing third to Rockstown Girl; meets that rival on same terms here on chase debut.
